faq.sectionSubtitle: Everything you need to know about IYTE Mobile

whatIsIyte.a: IYTE Mobile is a comprehensive campus application developed for students of Izmir Institute of Technology (IYTE). It offers features such as food menus, bus schedules, social feed, carpooling, instant messaging and academic documents.

platforms.q: Which platforms is IYTE Mobile available on?
platforms.a: IYTE Mobile is currently available for free on Android devices via Google Play Store. The iOS version will be published on the App Store soon.

foodMenu.q: Can I view the IYTE food menu from the app?
foodMenu.a: Yes, you can view daily cafeteria and KYK dorm menus, discover campus restaurants and leave reviews through IYTE Mobile.

ringService.q: Can I access IYTE ring bus schedules from the app?
ringService.a: Yes, you can view IYTE ring service times, ESHOT connection times, and weekday and weekend schedules separately on IYTE Mobile.

isPaid.a: Yes, IYTE Mobile is completely free. You can download it for free from the Google Play Store.

clubApplication.q: How do I add my club to İYTE Mobil?
clubApplication.a: The İYTE Mobil team creates the accounts for campus clubs and all clubs are listed in the app. If you manage a club, contact us at iytemobil@gmail.com or on Instagram and we will send you a personal activation link. After verifying your email and setting a password you can publish events and announcements in the app.

documents.q: How do I upload academic documents?
documents.a: Go to iytemobil.com/en/documents, select your department and click 'Upload Document' to upload exam papers, lecture notes and project files in PDF, DOC or DOCX format. Uploaded documents are published after approval.

anonymous.q: Can I post anonymously on the social feed?
anonymous.a: Yes, you can share anonymous confessions on the IYTE Mobile social feed. Posts marked as confessions are published with your identity hidden.

notifications.a: Yes, push notifications are active on IYTE Mobile. New message, like, comment and event notifications are delivered to your phone instantly. You can manage your notification preferences from the profile settings.

activities.q: What is an Activity and how do I create one?
activities.a: Activities are meetup listings designed for students who want to do things together on campus — like card games, billiards, swimming or hiking. Go to the Campus tab, tap 'Activities', then hit 'Create Activity' and fill in the title, location, date and maximum number of participants. Regular users can create activities for up to 10 people; clubs can host up to 1000.

joinActivity.q: How do I join an activity?
joinActivity.a: Browse activities on the social feed or in Campus > Activities. Tap an activity card to open its detail page and press 'Join'. Once an activity is full, joining closes automatically. You can leave an activity anytime from its detail page using the 'Leave' button.

clubs.a: Open the Clubs screen in the app to see all active campus clubs. Tap a club page and press 'Follow'. Events from clubs you follow will also appear in your social feed. You can browse a club's event calendar, announcements and past events from the same page.

quotePost.a: Open the detail page of any post and tap 'Quote'. Write your own comment and share it — the original post will appear as a small preview card below your new post.

carpool.a: Find active listings in Campus > Carpooling. To post your own listing, tap 'Create Listing' and enter the route, date, time and number of seats. When you find a suitable ride, contact the poster directly through in-app messaging.

representative.q: What does the Department Representative badge mean?
representative.a: Department representatives are designated users assigned by the app administration to represent their department. Posts from representatives are highlighted in the social feed with a green border and a 'Representative' label.
